article.headline: UAE Weather Forecast: Rain to Persist Across Northern and Eastern Regions
article.summary: The National Centre of Meteorology predicts rainfall will continue across northern, eastern, and southern UAE for the next five days.
article.body:
Wind speeds are expected to reach up to 50 km/h during the coming days, accompanied by rising dust and fresh to strong gusts near convective cloud formations. While conditions remain fair to partly cloudy, the presence of these clouds brings a consistent chance of rain throughout the end of the week, according to the National Centre of Meteorology (NCM).

Residents should prepare for humid mornings across coastal and inland areas, with a recurring possibility of fog or mist in the early hours. These unsettled conditions follow a recent period of heavy showers and hail that transformed landscapes from desert terrain to flowing wadis, prompting the Ministry of Interior to issue earlier safety guidelines for drivers to reduce speed and exercise caution.

Following Wednesday's forecast for rain in the north, east, and south, the NCM expects convective clouds to form over northern and eastern areas on Thursday, potentially extending into inland regions. Friday and Saturday will see similar patterns, with cloud activity focused in eastern areas bringing rainfall, while wind speeds are anticipated to taper slightly to 40 km/h. Sunday is expected to remain fair to partly cloudy with continued morning humidity, marking the end of the current five-day weather outlook.

news.title: Italy confirms its team to defend the Davis Cup without the mysterious presence of Berrettini
news.og_title: Italy confirms its team to defend the Davis Cup without the mysterious presence of Berrettini
news.og_desc: The champion is seeking her fourth consecutive salad bowl. Italy, which already has three Davis Cups in a row, wants to extend its reign even further, and Filippo Volandri has brought back a player for Bologna who couldn’t participate last year due to injury, namely Lorenzo Musetti. Additionally, there is also the newcomer Luciano Darderi, who is making his debut in a call-up. However, he retains last year's hero, Flavio Cobolli, and the doubles players Simone Bolelli and Andrea Vavassori. However, the absence of a key player like Matteo Berrettini is notable.Looking at Volandri's roster, Cobolli steps up to fill the void left vacant last year by Jannik Sinner and presents himself as the main Italian figure. Meanwhile, Musetti, who has had a very inconsistent year due to constant injuries, is expected to be the second option. Darderi will be the third player and could see action in Bologna if Cobolli or Musetti are not fit to take to the court in any of the ties.What will not be happening is Berrettini's participation, who demonstrated last year to be a key figure in Italy's title defense, winning all his matches from the first round to the final against Spain. His absence may extend beyond a purely sporting decision.Berrettini and Musetti may be going through a personal conflictOn social media, discussions are starting to arise about a poor relationship between Musetti and Berrettini, when they have always boasted of having a great friendship, also linked to certain personal problems between them and their partners. The arguments gaining more traction are two: that they no longer follow each other on social media and Berrettini's cold and dry response today when, after his victory in the first round of the ATP 500 in Vienna, he was asked about Musetti's win in Lyon.“Your friend Lorenzo Musetti just won a title after quite some time, does that serve as inspiration for you?” the TennisTV reporter asked on the court. The Italian's face completely changed, and he asked, “Are we live?” to which the interviewer confirmed that they were. “Well, that’s fine...
